svg.title: Energy levels of a ruby laser
svg.desc: Energy levels of chromium ions in an aluminum oxide crystal (ruby), drawn to scale: the ground state at 0.0 eV, a metastable first excited state at 1.79 eV, a second at 2.3 eV and a third at 3.0 eV. An animated companion below illustrates the process; its complete static alternative is shown for reduced motion and print.

g.text: A ruby-laser cycle releases stored excitation energy
Rounded book levels: pump 2.30 eV, nonradiative loss 0.51 eV, metastable energy 1.79 eV. A 1.79 eV
seed stimulates two outgoing photons; pump + seed = heat + output.
Illustrative motion • slowed down • cycle restarts
